notes.title: There are more cars on the road
notes.notes:
Added a stage where you can eat sandwiches while avoiding cars quickly.

When you advance the calendar to August, a car appears on the course

If you approach the car from behind, it will stall.

If you avoid from behind, you will be able to temporarily obtain items in a wide area.

It also makes you temporarily invincible to falling cats.

notes.title: Language settings have been added.
notes.notes:
ver 0.1.0.6 

When Japanese is selected in the language settings:

・Content in Settings will be localized into Japanese
・Some UI elements during gameplay will be localized into Japanese
・Parts of the result explanations will be localized into Japanese
・Story representation in endings, previously available in both English and Japanese, will now be available in only one language.
